entities.name: Eduard Čech

entities.summary: Eduard Čech was a Czech mathematician. His research interests included projective differential geometry and topology. He is especially known for the technique known as Stone–Čech compactification and the notion of Čech cohomology. He was the first to publish a proof of Tychonoff's theorem in 1937.

entities.summary: Eduard Čech was a Czech mathematician. His research interests included projective differential geometry and topology.
